sources.content:
Western Hills (Xishan) in Kunming - Complete Information

Overview
The Western Hills is situated approximately 15 kilometers west of Kunming's city center along Dianchi Lake's western shore. The area resembles "a reclining beauty from afar," earning it the nickname Sleeping Beauty Mountain. The highest peak reaches 2,507.5 meters elevation, providing expansive views of Kunming and the lake.

Key Details
- Chinese Name: 西山 (Xishan)
- Location: Near 1318 Dianchi Road, Xishan District
- Altitude Range: 1,900-2,350 meters
- Hours: 8:30-17:00 weekdays; 8:00-17:30 weekends
- Duration: Plan 3-4 hours
- Entry Fee: CNY 65 (includes cable way and sightseeing car)
- Optimal Season: March through October

Major Attractions

Dragon Gate Grottoes: This premier highlight features "stone carving art" spanning 66.5 meters along steep cliffs. Construction required 72 years and showcases carvings of 22 Taoist deities, 28 auspicious creatures, and ornate altar designs. Cable car access recommended.

Huating Temple: A Buddhist sanctuary established during the Yuan Dynasty, situated at 2,050 meters. The Wanghai Tower offers sunrise views over Dianchi Lake.

Taihua Temple: Located on the park's highest peak (2,500 meters), originally constructed during Yuan times and rebuilt in the Qing Dynasty, featuring ancient inscriptions and relics.

Sanqing Pavilion: A Taoist complex containing thirteen temples built in "hanging temple" style, primarily dating to the Qing period.

Transportation Options
- Public Transit: Multiple bus routes (101, 18, 61, C8, 6, F6, 94, 51, 44, 84, 237, 238, A1) and Metro Line 3
- Taxi: Approximately 30 minutes, CNY 35-45
- Distance: 15 kilometers from city center

Recommended Routes
1. Cable car from north entrance, explore grottoes south-to-northeast
2. Battery cart option with multiple scenic stops
3. South entrance access for Dragon Gate exploration

Nearby Attractions
- Yunnan Ethnic Village (9.5 km away)
- Dianchi Lake
- Green Lake Park (15 km distance)

sources.title: Western Hills, Kunming Xishan, Kunming Dragon Gate - China Discovery
sources.content:
Western Hills, Kunming

Western Hills is called 西山 (Xishan) in Chinese, and is a scenic forest park located in the west suburb of Kunming, 15km to the city center. They are also called 'Sleeping Buddha Hills', and when viewed from a distance, they look like a beautiful young lady laying beside Dianchi Lake with her face upward and her hair trailing into water.

The best time to visit is March to October, with recommended visiting hours of about 3 to 4 hours.

Dragon Gate is the largest and the most beautiful Taoist grottoes in Yunnan Province, featuring danger, tranquility and uniqueness, and was built in the Qing Dynasty more than 200 years ago, with a construction of 72 years.

Huating Temple was first built from 1320 AD and is the largest Buddhism temple in Kunming. Taihua Temple was built in Yuan Dynasty and was extended and repaired several times in Ming and Qing Dynasties.

Opening hours are 07:00-18:00 from March to October and 08:00-17:00 from November to February. Entrance fees are CNY 15 for Dragon Gate Grottoes and CNY 25 for Dragon Gate Cable Car (one-way).

Take metro line 3 and get off at Western Hills Station, then walk southeast around 1.5 kilometers to arrive.

sources.title: Western Hills Forest Park - China Highlights
sources.content:
Western Hills Forest Park, Kunming

The Western Hills (Xishan) is a scenic mountain area on the western shore of Dianchi Lake, about 15 km from Kunming city center. The mountain range stretches about 40 km and is home to temples, grottoes, and forest trails.

The highlight is the Dragon Gate (Longmen), a series of grottoes and sculptures carved into the cliff face over 72 years during the Qing Dynasty. The grottoes offer spectacular views over Dianchi Lake.

Other attractions include Huating Temple (one of Kunming's largest Buddhist temples), Taihua Temple, and the Sanqing Pavilion. The Nie Er Tomb, memorial to the composer of China's national anthem, is also located here.

The cable car from Yunnan Nationalities Village to the Dragon Gate provides convenient access and stunning aerial views of Dianchi Lake.

sources.title: Western Hills hike (Kunming, China)
sources.content:
Western Hills Hike, Kunming

The Western Hills (Xishan) in Kunming offer a scenic hiking experience along the shores of Dianchi Lake. The hike takes you through forested mountain paths, past ancient temples, and up to the famous Dragon Gate grottoes.

The Dragon Gate is the undisputed highlight - Taoist sculptures carved directly into cliff faces high above Dianchi Lake. The narrow pathways along the cliff edge provide thrilling views and a sense of the immense labor that went into creating these works over 72 years.

The hike can be done as a loop or one-way, with cable car options available for those who prefer not to walk the entire route. The total hiking time from the base to Dragon Gate is approximately 2-3 hours.

Please wear comfortable hiking shoes as there are many stairs in Dragon Gate Scenic Area. Pack a snack as shops in the forest park are limited and food is expensive.

sources.title: 昆明西山森林公园 - 百度百科
sources.content:
昆明西山森林公园完整信息

基本信息
昆明西山森林公园位于昆明西郊，距市区15公里。占地约889公顷，北起碧鸡关，南达灰湾。最高峰海拔2507.5米，罗汉山高出滇池水面约620多米。
开放时间：周一至周日 08:30-17:00
门票：免费入园，景区内景点单独收费

地理特征
远眺西山群峰，宛如"睡美人"仰卧于滇池岸边。森林覆盖率达94%。分布有167个科、594个属、1086种植物，药用植物超90种。

主要景点

龙门石窟：位于罗汉山悬崖，包含石道、古室、古栏、古窟、古佛等。清乾隆至咸丰年间历时十余年开凿，是西山精华所在。1983年被列为云南省重点文物保护单位。门票40元。

达天阁：龙门南端石窟，内有魁星、文昌、关圣等神像，均在原生岩石上雕凿而成。

华亭寺：位于华亭山，海拔2050米，创建于14世纪。殿宇规模宏伟，内有五百罗汉塑像。

太华寺：14世纪初建立，花木繁盛。望海楼为观看滇池日出的佳处。

聂耳墓：位于太华山与罗汉山之间。聂耳（1912-1935）是人民音乐家，作有《义勇军进行曲》等。1986年被公布为全国重点文物保护单位。

玉兰园：占地66亩，全国最大玉兰专类园，种植白玉兰、紫玉兰等千余株。

小石林：位于罗汉山巅，喀斯特地貌景观。

设施与服务
公园设有游客咨询中心、语音导游系统。年游客量超300万人次。

交通路线
地铁3号线西山公园站A口出；6路公交从梁家河出发（每8分钟一班）；云南民族村可乘高空缆车直达龙门（35元/人）。

sources.title: Kunming Western Hills and Dragon Gate Travel - Yunnan Exploration
sources.content:
Kunming Western Hills and Dragon Gate Travel Guide

The Western Hills (Xishan) is a mountain range on the western shore of Dianchi Lake, about 15 km from Kunming city center. The area is famous for the Dragon Gate grottoes, ancient temples, and panoramic views of Dianchi Lake.

The Dragon Gate (Longmen) is the most famous attraction, featuring Taoist sculptures carved into cliff faces during the Qing Dynasty. The work took 72 years to complete and represents one of the finest examples of cliff carving in China.

Other attractions include Huating Temple, Taihua Temple, Sanqing Pavilion, and the Nie Er Memorial. The area can be explored on foot or by cable car.

Practical information: The scenic area is open from 8:00 to 17:30. Dragon Gate entrance fee is CNY 40. Cable car from Yunnan Nationalities Village to Dragon Gate costs CNY 35 one-way.
